title: Italian Hoagie Sandwiches
description: Classic Italian-style sandwiches featuring juicy meats, crispy vegetables, and crunchy flatbread. Perfect for a quick lunch or dinner.

ingredients.name: Crunchy Vegetables
ingredients.notes: such as bell peppers and onions

instructions: 1. Preheat a panini press or grill to medium-high heat.
2. Slice the cold cuts and cheese into thin strips.
3. Layer the flatbread with cold cuts, cheese, lettuce, and vegetables.
4. Drizzle Italian dressing over the top.
5. Brush olive oil onto the flatbread.
6. Season with salt and pepper to taste.
7. Place the sandwiches onto the preheated press or grill.
8. Cook for 3-5 minutes or until the cheese is melted and the bread is crispy.
